note_en: 以…为例 (yǐ… wéi lì) is the standard way to introduce an example, literally "taking ... as an example": 以申根签证为例 "take the Schengen visa, for example," 以上海为例 "take Shanghai, for example." Unlike English "for example," which can go almost anywhere, it always opens the sentence and wraps around the thing being cited.
